profile.headline: Senior Fullstack Software Engineer at Modivcare
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Former project management/operations professional turned Software Engineer, with a specialty in Full-stack development.

I have a passion for continuously learning new things to add to my engineering abilities by creating side applications and trying new tools!

Technologies I have experience with include:
Front-End: HTML5, CSS3, React, React Native, Redux, Styled Components
Back-End: C#, Node.js & Express, SQL
Full-Stack: JavaScript (Vanilla, ES6+), TypeScript, Next.js
Testing: (React) Testing Library, Jest, Vitest
Misc: .NET Framework/Core, Azure, REST APIs, Jira, Storybook, Vite

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented Azure-hosted C# microservices handling 700k+ API calls daily, leveraging Azure App Services, Service Bus, SQL/Cosmos DB, and WebJobs to build scalable, resilient distributed systems.
• Lead migration of legacy microservices from .NET Framework to .NET Core; successfully upgraded 14 of 26 services to date, improving scalability and reducing production incidents by 30%.
• Architected and executed migration of a legacy Create React App v4 codebase to a React + TypeScript + Vite stack, enhancing maintainability and type safety while reducing bug rates by 20% and accelerating local development startup by 30%.
• Lead feature architecture and technical design reviews with backend teams, aligning a 10-engineer team and reducing implementation ambiguity and rework across releases.
• Mentored junior engineers, upheld code quality standards through reviews, and drove adoption of frontend best practices across the team.

positions.title: Frontend Engineer
positions.description:
• Build cross-platform features using TypeScript, React, and React Native, optimizing performance and ensuring accessible UI across web and mobile.
• Built and maintained a reusable Storybook component library, standardizing design patterns and reducing duplicate UI implementations.
• Increased frontend test coverage by 55% using Vitest and React Testing Library, reducing regression defects and improving release stability.
• Optimized Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for mobile applications, reducing build times by 35 minutes and accelerating release cycles.
• Partnered with design and backend teams to deliver scalable, user-centered UI features, reducing implementation ambiguity and improving delivery predictability.
• Established frontend architectural standards and documentation, improving code consistency and accelerating onboarding for new engineers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Co-led the planning and development of EcoBridge's web application, using NextJS, Styled Components, and AWS Amplify.
- Defined API routes and database schemas to store user information in AWS databases.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Next.js · Agile Project Management · Full-Stack Development · React.js

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Designed form templates in Figma for internal administrative use, implemented using React and Redux.
- The in-house form system resulted in savings of approximately $200 monthly.

• Result of an in-house form system led to unsubscribing to a form service, saving ~$200
monthly.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Front-End Development · redux · React.js

positions.title: Project Coordinator
positions.description:
•Reduced sunk costs by 5% by determining project requirements within the project’s planning stage.
•Monitored and tracked project deliverable and invoices from vendors and construction contractors.
•Collaborated with Site Acquisition and Construction teams on fulfilling client’s requirements per project milestone, and develop process improvement.
•Managed the compliance process by ordering documentation per project specifications, and submitting completed deliverable to the client’s CM. 
•Supported the Project Manager by preparing Service Orders and forecasting milestones.
•Worked closely with the Project team to create weekly PowerPoint slides to discuss achievements and upcoming critical items.
•Scheduled and prioritized team activities and day-to-day tasks with Trello.
•Manipulated and extracted necessary data to measure project progress, such as Service Order sales, monthly third-party costs, and forecasts achieved, via VLOOKUP and PivotTables.

positions.title: Operations Coordinator
positions.description:
•Functioned as a liaison between the departments of Finance, Human Resources, and Office Management to develop and implement strategic solutions, increasing productivity by 15% among personnel, and developing measurable metrics for future cost-savings. 
•Facilitated the company’s Operations Management and Standards meeting to discuss monthly goals, resolve issues, and establish new milestones. Develop a postmortem if goals are overdue or have not met expectations for future quality control.
•Developed successful training courseware for new employees to educate in the firm’s standards and tools, and accelerate in career development.
•Managed the firm’s IT Operations, which includes technology budget & forecasting, and ticket log.
•Moderated 3 technicians to complete the company-wide workstation upgrade with a $50K+ annual budget. The project is to upgrade the workstations for all employees in order to increase productivity and decrease maintenance cost within the scope of hardware and software specifications per department.
•Scheduled project meetings with stakeholders and tracked minutes to summarize meeting discussions and team action items.
•Oversaw the project closeout and archiving processes to reduce the search downtime on project documents by 20%.
•Coordinated with Project Managers, Project Administration, Accounting and other internal stakeholders to ensure projects are up to date with manpower and milestones (30-50 active projects per Project Manager).
•Led a team of 5 to develop and implement new CRM software. The project expanded sales by implementing strategies to track prospects and pursue business opportunities.
